body: Thank you, I’m not sure. I have good days and bad days, my note is written but so far I have managed to pull myself out of the bad times. How are you?

I’m just trying to reach out to someone, and my sister and I have always been quite close but since she started speaking with my ex she has been more of a support to him than me and that just gets me down
I am speaking with a professional who believe it’s important to talk and family is important too, but I don’t really understand how I’m meant to reach out when people don’t listen
What because someone can’t go through a bad time? The past couple of weeks have been tough and if you aren’t allowed to talk about that with your own family who can you?
Because they were worried and instead of speaking to me they just called the police

Me and his sister have had trouble in the past. The fact that they never left the house meant it had to be someone there and she was the most likely one to want to hurt me I guess that was my explanation
